title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books

author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author seeking experienced character artists for dark fantasy book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT. Contact via Threads replies.

author: Carolina
title: Looking for 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator! I’m looking for a creative talent who can: * Create flat character illustrations (2D). * Design and develop 3D characters. * Animate characters in both 2D and 3D. Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus. If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com

author: Meg Humble
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs. Authors please also rec people you have used! Contact via comments (no DMs).

author: Bill Adler
title: Looking for artist to illustrate short stories
content: I'm looking for an artist illustrate my short stories. I write speculative fiction: scifi, magical realism, horror, and fantasy. Color or black and white drawings are ok. There's a link to my stories in my bio. Payment in the 10,000 yen range per drawing. Best contact via Substack DMs.

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character artist for upcoming book with flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! Contact via Threads.
